source: docs/research/agent-skills.md section 1.4 and 4.4 (host docs as documented on 2026-10-03); copilot, factory and kiro paths as gstack installs them (its hosts/*.ts, read 2026-10-05)
note: Install into agents + claude-code by default: Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and OpenCode read one of those two, so installing into every compatible dir at one scope produces duplicates. "auto" also installs for each host whose detect folder exists in your home. Other hosts are opt-in.

hosts.name: Claude Code
hosts.notes: does not document .agents/skills; plugin skills would be namespaced /cstack:<skill>

hosts.name: Codex
hosts.notes: drops skills with descriptions over 1024 chars; optional <skill>/agents/openai.yaml generated from skill.meta.json host_overrides

hosts.name: Cursor
hosts.notes: also reads .agents/skills and .claude/skills; do not install to both

hosts.name: Gemini CLI
hosts.notes: activation asks the user for consent; .agents/skills alias wins within a tier

hosts.name: OpenCode
hosts.notes: enforces name regex ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ and name == directory

hosts.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
hosts.notes: paths as gstack installs them; whether it also reads .claude/skills is unverified, so it is opt-in or auto-detected
